title: Total EXHAUST™ Ducted Fume Hoods
meta_title: Total EXHAUST Ducted Fume Hoods - Air Science
meta_description: Air Science's Total EXHAUST™ ducted fume hoods provide personnel protection from hazardous agents and toxic chemicals with horizontal and vertical airflow across the work surface.
meta_keywords: ducted fume hoods, total exhaust, air science, fume hoods, laboratory equipment
short_description: Total EXHAUST™ ducted fume hoods use horizontal and vertical airflow across the work surface to provide personnel protection from hazardous agents and toxic chemicals. These hoods are connected to the facility exhaust system.
full_description: Air Science manufactures 6 standard sizes of Total EXHAUST™ ducted fume hoods for new and replacement installations. Custom sizes are available for special equipment or instrumentation. These hoods feature an ergonomic design with easy access and uniform non-glare lighting.
seo_content: The Total EXHAUST™ line of ducted fume hoods from Air Science are designed to meet any specialized filtration need. Common applications include forensics, education, microscopy, pharmaceutical, powder weighing, sample preparation, veterinary, and dental work.

Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.

page_content_sections.overview: Air Science manufactures 6 standard sizes for new and replacement installations. Custom sizes available for special equipment or instrumentation. Ergonomic design with easy access and uniform non-glare lighting.
page_content_sections.specifications: The Total EXHAUST™ ducted fume hoods from Air Science are constructed of polypropylene and comply with OSHA, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards. They feature horizontal and vertical airflow with an upflow direction.
page_content_sections.applications: Common applications for Air Science's Total EXHAUST™ ducted fume hoods include forensics, education, microscopy, pharmaceutical, powder weighing, sample preparation, veterinary, and dental work.
page_content_sections.models: Air Science offers 6 standard model sizes of the Total EXHAUST™ ducted fume hoods, ranging from 24" to 96" in width, all with 115VAC, 60Hz electrical requirements.
